article_notes: Necropsy case series of six B. canis (PCR-confirmed) non-survivors from two veterinary clinics in Poland (17 deaths among 272 cases; 6 with owner consent for necropsy). Admission biochemistry and haematology are given per dog (Table 1), all before treatment, but there is no comparison group of survivors and no test against severity or outcome. Nothing to extract. Setting given as primary clinic because the article says 'two veterinary clinics' without stating referral status.
